sourceSummary: Sign-in for the Swag Labs demo storefront — with two deliberately broken cases, for the heal demo.

testCases.title: Valid credentials land the shopper on the product catalogue
preconditions: The standard_user account is not locked out
testCases.rationale: The primary path. If this breaks, every other case is untestable.

testCases.title: A wrong password is rejected with the generic credentials error
testCases.expectedResult: The error message "Epic sadface: Your credentials are invalid" is visible.
testCases.rationale: Catches a wrong password being accepted, and confirms the error does not reveal whether the username exists.

testCases.title: Submitting an empty form asks for the username first
testCases.expectedResult: The error message "Epic sadface: Username is required" is visible.
testCases.rationale: Catches an empty submission reaching the authentication backend instead of being stopped at the form.

testCases.title: A username with no password is rejected on the password field
testCases.expectedResult: The error message "Epic sadface: Password is required" is visible.
testCases.rationale: The empty-password boundary: catches a blank password being treated as a match against an empty stored hash.

testCases.title: A locked-out account is refused even with the correct password
preconditions: The locked_out_user account has been locked by an administrator
testCases.expectedResult: The error message "Epic sadface: Sorry, this user has been locked out." is visible.
testCases.rationale: Catches the lockout flag being stored but never checked during authentication — valid credentials would sail straight through.

testCases.title: The password field is masked at all times

steps.action: Read the type attribute of the Password field
steps.expectedObservation: It is "password", so the typed value is masked

testCases.expectedResult: The password is never rendered as readable text.
testCases.rationale: Catches a field that renders as plain text, exposing the password to anyone looking at the screen or a screen recording.
